kv12.3:1.3: sukhavedanīyo dukkhavedanīyo adukkhamasukhavedanīyo, sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, phassena sampayutto vedanāya sampayutto saññāya sampayutto cetanāya sampayutto cittena sampayutto sārammaṇo.
kv12.3:1.4: atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhī’ti.
kv12.3:1.6: nanu na sukhavedanīyo na dukkhavedanīyo …pe… anārammaṇo. natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti,
kv12.3:1.8: hañci na sukhavedanīyo …pe… anārammaṇo. natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, no ca vata re vattabbe
kv12.3:2.1: phasso vipāko, phasso sukhavedanīyo …pe… sārammaṇo. atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv12.3:2.3: saddo vipāko, saddo sukhavedanīyo …pe… sārammaṇo. atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv12.3:3.1: saddo vipāko, saddo na sukhavedanīyo …pe… anārammaṇo. natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv12.3:3.3: phasso vipāko, phasso na sukhavedanīyo na dukkhavedanīyo …pe… anārammaṇo. natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv12.3:4.5: “so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā brahmassaro hoti karavīkabhāṇī”ti.
